proposals.evidence: DEDR 3559 full article (p. 312) gives Kor. (M.) tōru skin. Te. tokka skin, bark, rind; tōlu skin, hide, leather. Kol. (Kin., Haig, Hislop) tōl skin, hide. Nk. tōl skin. Nk. (Ch.) tōl id. Pa. tōl skin, bark. Ga. (Oll.) tōl id. Bhat tōru “skin” matches Lindgren Koraga tōru “leather or hide” in form and sense; this cross-source match is a candidate lead, with the full DEDR article defining the family. Both source identities and dialect tags are preserved.
